findings.reason: F0003:S2:T1:A3 states single meropenem doses but explicitly leaves the PK route unstated. Efficacy dosing was i.p.; the separate cyclophosphamide i.p. schedule also cannot establish meropenem PK administration. Formulation or active-moiety dose basis and input duration are NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported meropenem PK route, dose basis, dosing time origin and any applicable administration duration; retain the three printed single-dose amounts independently.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T1:A4 reports one-compartment modeling and explicitly states that sampling times and mice per time point are not stated and no concentration table or figure was published. The table contains parameters, not concentration-time observations. Actual body weights, experimental-unit identifiers and potential holdout membership are NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: Permitted source-linked concentration-time records and sampling metadata if available, or downstream documentation limiting this item to reported-parameter or exploratory use. Do not construct observations from the fitted parameters.

findings.reason: MI014 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at pk: Support for individual PK variability. F0003:S2:T1 supplies reported PK parameters without individual identifiers, sampling counts or reported variability. Cardiac puncture does not establish serial animal identity, and parameter point estimates cannot establish individual variability. A defensible individual-variability basis for subsequent population predictions has not been established.
findings.needed_material: At PK work, assess verified individual records, sampling structure or traceable reported variability; record supported variability or the resulting limitation without manufacturing it from group summaries.

findings.reason: MI005 remains CONFLICT, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at pk: Mouse within-species protein-binding source conflict. F0003:S2:T1:A5 supplies the source-specific 10% protein-binding input cited from S07. This page does not resolve the conflicting mouse sources identified in the supplied context. A single resolved mouse binding value cannot be used for free-exposure interpretation or translation.
findings.needed_material: Retain the source-specific alternatives and assess their applicability under SC042 without averaging them; carry fu as a sensitivity parameter at the appropriate downstream stage.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T1:A5 reports a percentage called protein binding used for fT>MIC and attributes it to S07. It does not provide a directly measured free concentration or explicitly define fu versus bound fraction. The binding measurement matrix, method, experimental conditions, concentration range, recovery and nonspecific binding are NOT_FOUND. The PK plasma assay in A4 does not establish the cited binding experiment's matrix or method.
findings.needed_material: Authorized evidence defining the cited binding percentage and its species, analyte, matrix, method, conditions and applicability to the requested unbound endpoints; preserve the printed percentage without conversion.

findings.reason: Total CL values in F0003:S2:T1:B7-B9 are source-backed reported-parameter candidates in liters/h/kg. F0003:S2:T1:A4 identifies a one-compartment model, but the PK route is unstated and the page does not establish absolute CL versus an apparent parameter, the dose composition basis, detailed estimation method or uncertainty. The Total AUC integration window is NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: Retain the estimates as LITERATURE_REPORTED, NOT_RECALCULATED and NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED. Obtain the applicable clearance definition, route, dose basis, exposure window and reported uncertainty before dependent use; do not require or perform a new fit at this stage.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T1:C7-C9 provide Total AUC by dose in mg·h/liter. A free-AUC input, integration window and time origin, matched strain MIC, response records and regimen-to-response mapping are NOT_FOUND on this page. The cited binding percentage does not itself establish a free-AUC conversion or an exposure-response link.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported AUC window and free-exposure basis, applicable binding assessment, matched strain MIC and traceable regimen-response relationships before fAUC/MIC comparison.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T1:D7-D9 provide reported Cmax values by dose in mg/liter. The source does not specify whether these peaks are sampled or model-derived, their total/free basis or peak window. Matched strain MIC and response links are NOT_FOUND on this page.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported peak definition, concentration basis, applicable window and time origin, binding inputs where needed, matched strain MIC and regimen-response mapping before fCmax/MIC comparison.

findings.reason: The single-dose amounts 30, 100 and 300 mg/kg in F0003:S2:T1:A3 repeat the table doses in A7-A9. These are repeated statements of the same dose levels, not additional administrations or experimental units.
findings.needed_material: Carry the text-stated dose values separately for preparation confirmation and preserve their links to the matching table rows without duplicating dosing events.
